info.title: AutoPwnDoc REST API
info.description: Interactive documentation for the AutoPwnDoc REST API. Authenticate requests with an API key in the `X-API-Key` header (or a logged-in browser session). API keys have administrator-level access, so keep them secret. Standard JSON responses use `{ status, datas }`; file-download endpoints return a file instead.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Create and revoke API keys in Settings > API. The same key can also be sent as a Bearer token.
